title: Skip-to-content link is treated as a hash route and replaces the current view with 'Page not found'
test: tests/browser/ui-semantics.spec.mjs: 'skip to content on /#watch focuses main and keeps the view mounted' and 'skip to content on /#host focuses main and keeps the view mounted' (chromium and mobile-chrome projects)
proof: Before the fix (build of the unchanged src/App.jsx) both tests failed: on /#host, 'Page not found' heading count was 1 where 0 was expected and the URL hash became '#main'; on /#watch the .join-form view was not found after Enter on the skip link. After the fix all four runs pass; full ui-semantics.spec.mjs passes 40/40 on chromium and mobile-chrome.
